comments.author: Claudia
comments.body:
You can get below items from this box:

Soma -status recovery r5
Asclepius' elixir -medical treatment r20
Assorted ointments -medical treatment (multiple) r5
Assorted medications -medical treatment (multiple) r10
Assorted elixirs -medical treatment (multiple) r15
Maracuja juice -gradual recovery r9
Maracuja bottle -gradual recovery (multiple) r9
Analeptic -revival r1
Medicine of the Medici -medical treatment (multiple) r20

I don't think there is anything else because I opened 256 boxes consecutively.

comments.author: Steward
comments.body: That's a great experiment. I'm currently collecting the tickets you get from investing in Bergen to see what's availble when I use 200 or so at once. Did you happen to keep track of how much you got of each item? Like, 40 of the chests produces Soma, 50 produced Assorted Ointments, etc.?
